transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Um... I guess my mind just keeps going blank. At the worst times. Like, I'll just... look at the road-closure forms at work, or my stop-slow paddle, and... suddenly I can't remember the steps. Things I've done for years. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do these memory blanks happen outside of work too?
I don't really know. Um... maybe? I just... I haven't really noticed it as much at home. I don't do much when I'm not on shift, so... mostly just at work, I think.
Right before your mind goes blank at work, do you feel especially anxious or under pressure?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I'm just... doing my job, holding the sign, and then... it just happens. I don't feel nervous or anything beforehand.
After one of these blank spells ends, can you remember what happened during it?
Um... no. Not really. It's just... blank. I don't really know what happens during it. It's just gone.
When you are having one of these blank spells, do you keep carrying out your work tasks, or do you stop and become visibly confused?
I'm not sure. I mean... I don't remember it, so... I don't know what I'm doing when it happens. No one's ever said anything to me about it, so... I guess I just keep standing there.
When did these memory blanks first begin?
Um... I guess... maybe a year and eight months ago. Around then. It... it started after my closest friend passed away.
Before your friend died, did you regularly have similar problems with attention or remembering things?
No... not that I can think of. I mean, I always did my job fine. It just... it wasn't like this before.
Outside of work, do you have trouble remembering recent conversations or appointments?

Um... I don't know. Maybe. I don't really go out much to have appointments. 

I just... the main reason I came in is because my mind keeps going blank at the worst times. Like... I'll look at the road-closure forms, or... or my stop-slow paddle... and I suddenly can't remember the steps. Things I've done for years. It just... goes completely blank.
Between the blank spells, does your memory feel normal, or are you forgetful much of the time?
I... I'm not really sure. I guess it feels normal enough. I just... I don't really notice it unless it goes blank.
Do you have gaps in your memory for important personal events or information about your own life?
No. I... I know who I am and what's happened in my life. It's just... the work stuff, mostly.
Has a doctor identified a medical or neurological condition that could be causing these memory problems?
No. Um... I haven't really seen any other doctors about it. So... no. Not that I know of.
When you later realize you had a blank spell, do coworkers tell you that you continued doing your job correctly during it?
I... I don't really talk to the rest of the crew about it. So... I'm not sure. They haven't said anything to me.
Has anyone ever told you that, during one of these blank spells, you seemed awake but unresponsive or behaved unusually?
No, um... no one's ever said anything like that. I just... I don't really know. Like I said, they don't say much to me.
Do these blank spells happen when something reminds you of your friend who died?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed a connection like that. They just... they just happen. I don't really know.
Do you have trouble remembering things you learned recently outside of work?
No... not really. I don't... I don't really do much outside of work anyway, so... I haven't noticed anything like that.
How long does a typical blank spell last?
Um... I'm not really sure. I mean, it's hard to tell how much time passes when it happens... so, I couldn't really tell you. I just don't know.
Since these blank spells began, have you been making more mistakes at work than you did before?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I stopped being reliable. I couldn't finish the road-closure paperwork... and I didn't really trust myself with the traffic-safety steps anymore. I just... I kind of pulled away from everything else, too. Choir, volunteering... my family. They're the ones who felt they had to bring me in for help.
During a blank spell, do you feel detached from yourself or as though the world around you is unreal?
Um... no. I don't think so. It's just... blank, I guess. I don't really feel like things are unreal or... anything like that. It's just nothing.
Have people close to you noticed memory or thinking problems in your everyday life outside of work?

Um... yeah, they noticed. That's... really why I came in, because they saw it happening. My mind just keeps going blank at the worst times. Like I was saying before... I'll just look at the road-closure forms, or my stop-slow paddle, and... suddenly I cannot remember the steps I've done for years. It's just gone. So... yeah. They see it.
Have your family noticed you forgetting ordinary conversations or instructions at home?

Um... yeah. Like I just said... my mind just keeps going blank. It's not just with the road forms or the paddle at work. It happens with them at home, too. They'll tell me something and... it's just gone. I guess that's why they brought me here.
